reviewerScope: B: experience context, project decision lifecycle and related supervisor UI wiring

verdict.reason: Decision projection has two deterministic command/branch failures. Fixing those alone does not supply missing real option eligibility evidence or complete actual-action and notification wiring.

confirmedFindings.title: Record/change and select reuse one idempotency command, so the selected projection cannot commit
confirmedFindings.trigger: An event has projectionSelection and its record/change returned a proposed decision.
confirmedFindings.cause: Both record/change and select receive commandId=e.eventId under the same actor. ProjectDecisionRuntime keys commands by actor/id while its fingerprint includes operation and input. Select therefore always conflicts with the preceding stored command.
confirmedFindings.result: The catch recovers the original proposal by its source basis reference, inserts the event link and allows the projection to complete. The existing-link branch never retries selection. Subsequent instruction/result projection only accepts selected or implemented decisions, so its action record is skipped.
confirmedFindings.minimalChange: Use deterministic, distinct, valid UUID command identities per event and operation, and make the phase state/replay resume through select rather than equating a proposal link with full lifecycle completion. Preserve CAS and all original history. Selection must still pass the real eligibility guard.
confirmedFindings.verificationNeeded: Bound real selected event -> committed selected revision -> real dispatch receipt -> signed result action, including replay and restart without duplicate revisions/actions.

confirmedFindings.title: Correction targeting an existing decision calls the record entry that explicitly rejects changeOf
confirmedFindings.trigger: A correction resolves its original event/current decision to an existing ProjectDecision.
confirmedFindings.cause: The branch uses change only when prior exists AND kind is not correction; the actual correction falls through to record(changeOf=prior.id). The record entry rejects every non-null changeOf before recording a command.
confirmedFindings.result: The durable projection remains pending; it cannot produce the required linked change proposal or later supersession. Initial-goal correction without an existing projected decision does not exercise this branch.
confirmedFindings.minimalChange: Route a correction with an existing decision through change with the exact prior revision. Preserve the original revision and defer supersession until a valid new selection; never overwrite old facts or label a proposal as implemented.
confirmedFindings.verificationNeeded: An actual selected/implemented source decision, owner correction to its exact event/hash, CAS conflict preservation, linked proposed change, valid selection/supersession, replay/restart, and immutable previous action evidence.

facts: The actual strict executor feedback schema accepts options only as string[].

The actual model adapter accepts exactly action/directive/reason/selectedOption/criteria/experienceReferences; selectedOption is string|null. It cannot express structured option goal/authority/environment/reversibility evidence.
deriveDecisionProjection converts string options to unknown eligibility, nonempty missingEvidence and empty coveredObjectives, and freezes context.objectives as an empty array.

The ProjectDecision recommendation/AI selection guard correctly rejects these options. Merely fixing the duplicate command identifier will expose DECISION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED instead of making a real AI selected branch reachable.

Instruction/result projection currently writes actions only when the projected ledger record is selected or implemented. A true dispatched instruction can therefore lack a ledger action even while the independently stored supervisor instruction event exists.
realOptionEligibilityBoundary.minimalRequirement: Keep unsupported alternatives proposed. Make any supported selected branch consume actual source-bound structured eligibility and goal facts; do not manufacture yes/available, erase missingEvidence, set human origin for AI, or weaken the guard. Preserve the actual dispatch/result action evidence independently even when decision eligibility remains unresolved. Test both a genuinely eligible source branch and an unqualified branch.

sourceImprovementsConfirmed: The selected/excluded/reminder context is now frozen as a full context hash and rechecked after model return and at dispatch, including the empty-selected case. New records and exclusion/cap changes are represented by the recomputed context rather than selected references alone.

Top-level verified plus matching verifiedContent/verifiedConditions/evidence remains the authority gate. Unknown conditions, project/machine/executor/native-version mismatch, archived/deprecated/superseded state and counterexamples remain exclusions.
Only the first five eligible records are selected; other eligible records now retain selected-cap-exceeded as an exclusion/reminder reason.
Exact selected record revision/hash checks remain in addition to the context hash.
experienceContext.notClaimed: The saved affected HTTP test changes an already selected experience; it does not establish the excluded/new/empty/cap concurrent-change matrix. Missing cases do not by themselves prove the new implementation wrong.
focusedRemainingCases: Change an excluded record so it becomes qualified, or record a new qualified lesson, after the model input was frozen and before dispatch.
Start with no selected references, then add/qualify one; change the sixth/capped record or its ranking identity.
Apply counterexample/deprecate/supersede or native version change at the freeze boundary; assert zero stale dispatch and no duplicate model invocation.

The current outcome-generated candidate is filtered by source marker during recheck. Exercise owner modification/verification of that same-source record before dispatch to establish that the self-generated candidate exclusion cannot hide a newly authoritative change. This is a focused unverified branch, not a reported reproduced failure.

correctionPauseSemantics.current_followup: Explicitly increments decision context revision, revokes the old goal policy, disables and pauses the session, cancels an active run and discards old model/dispatch intents. The UI describes the active round safe stop. The paused resume UI explicitly creates a new continuous authorization, including acknowledging unknown history.
correctionPauseSemantics.future_reference: Appends the correction without revoking the active policy or pausing the current loop.
correctionPauseSemantics.classification: The current_followup behavior is an explicit pause/revoke-old-authorization contract, not independently reported as an accidental cost/permission regression. The full correction -> actual stop proof -> legitimate reauthorization -> new dispatch lifecycle is still unaccepted. It must not clear historical usage or turn unknown cost into zero.

confirmedSource: The supervision route and project selector reach ProjectOversightPage and mount the real ProjectSupervisorPanel in live mode.
The panel uses project-scoped authenticated API calls, exact event/hash correction, fact/preference correctionType and current_followup/future_reference applyTo.
The authenticated event-history route and visible load-earlier button reach records beyond the latest 100. The saved HTTP pagination test exercises this API path.
Project-scoped SSE refresh and timed fallback reload exist. This is panel refresh, not background notification delivery.
The reminders link reaches settings/policy and the existing live NotificationPreferencesPanel. Existing supervision-work/task durable notifications remain connected.
uiAndNotificationWiring.remainingFeature: The new private supervisor judgment/wait-user/question/status events have no direct notification adapter/outbox call. The existing supervision-work runtime consumes repository task/work events, not these private supervisor events. Related task notifications cannot prove a supervisor judgment notification was emitted. Connect the narrow event family to the existing durable notification path with stable event identity and owner/project scope; do not build a separate notification system.
uiAndNotificationWiring.notVerified: Browser rendering, interactions, delivery preferences on a real signed-in account, background/mobile notification delivery and actual 112-model/101-CC operation were not exercised by this review.

savedTestEvidence.scope: Saved logs report real HTTP/SQLite/TCP signatures/runner/child/journal mechanisms with deterministic model/native-format fixtures; they do not establish real supplier or site acceptance. Build/typecheck/package exit 0 are author-reported saved evidence, not fresh reviewer runs.
specificLimits: The correction regression targets an initial goal event without an existing decision; it asserts a proposed projection, not an existing selected decision changeOf/supersession lifecycle.
The experience HTTP regression changes a selected reference only; the author report explicitly retains excluded/new/empty matrix work.
The author report explicitly retains selected instruction/result actions plus correction/changeOf full integration and browser/controlled field acceptance.
The real history cursor regression and new UI entrance close the earlier lack of discoverable >100 access in source/fixture scope; no browser acceptance is inferred.

minimalR9Handoff: Fix the two exact projection command/branch defects with CAS-safe, replayable per-phase identities.
Keep real unqualified options proposed; establish a true source-bound eligible option/goal branch and independently preserve performed instruction/result facts.
Add the narrow full decision lifecycle and concurrent experience-context boundary cases using actual HTTP/domain/SQLite paths, not an assertion of proposal creation alone.
Connect important private supervisor state/question events to the existing durable notification system; verify owner scope/idempotency and retain exact safe evidence.
